news.analysis: Williams was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He set a new career high with 155 rushing yards over the course of the game, and he was also able to get into the end zone towards the end of the game, which was the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with his performance in this primetime matchup.

news.contents: New York Jets running back Breece Hall (quadriceps) will be limited in Wednesday's practice, according to Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic. Hall missed a fourth straight game in the Week 7 loss to the division-rival Miami Dolphins, but a return to a limited practice in the first session of Week 8 preparation is potentially a sign that the 25-year-old will return this Sunday to face the Las Vegas Raiders.
